lines.text: Auger, TOPSIDE. You are cleared to descend. Keep the chatter on channel two.
Auger, this is TOPSIDE. Your manifest is approved. Do not open the sealed crates.
Copy your first bite, Auger. Mind the drill room temperature. We have lost crews to impatience.
TOPSIDE reads a fire aboard. Put it out, Auger. The paperwork for a fire is worse than the fire.
Water in the lower deck. Pumps first, questions later.
Auger, your hull telemetry is ugly. Patch what you can. We are not sending anyone.
Unregistered rig on your scope. They are not friends. They are not ours, either.
Good work. Do not salvage their logs. Send them up unread.
We copy the loss. Log it and keep moving, Auger.
Interesting find. Recalibrate and disregard.
Seismic says something large is moving behind you. Do not stop to look.
That is the gate, Auger. Nobody has come back up through it. Nobody has tried.
Auger, TOPSIDE. Weather up here is clear. You will not be needing that information.
Copy, Auger. We have your heading. We had it before you did.
Fire on your telemetry, Auger. Smother it. Do not vent smoke toward the rock.
You are taking water, Auger. Keep it out of the reactor room and we can discuss the rest.
Hull at critical. Your contract has a clause for this, Auger. You would not enjoy it.
Hostile rig. You are authorized to defend the hardware. The crew is covered under a separate line item.
Copy the kill. Their tower was never registered, so neither was this.
Loss confirmed. Their replacement is already - Disregard. Carry on with the crew you have.
TOPSIDE has logged your find, Auger. It was already in the log.
Reduce drill noise now, Auger. Do not ask us what is listening.
Gate on your scope. The last crew through reported warm air. We do not have the rest of that transmission.
That trader is not on our books, Auger. Pay in gems, not names.
Auger, TOPSIDE. You have broken into a void that is not on the survey. Note the contents. Do not note them aloud.
Copy the break-in. That construction predates your clearance, Auger. Most of what you find will.
Any sealed container in there is program property. Even the ones we did not - Disregard. Open with care.
